title: Kaempferide enhances antioxidant capacity to promote osteogenesis through FoxO1/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Ma, Xiaoli; Tian, Ye; Xue, Kaiyue; Huai, Ying; Patil, Suryaji; Deng, Xiaoni; Hao, Qiang; Li, Danming; Miao, Zhiping; Zhang, Wenjuan; Qian, Airong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山奈酚通过FoxO1/β-catenin信号通路促进成骨，仅用分子对接辅助筛选天然抗氧化剂，核心是细胞实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Forkhead box O1 (FoxO1)/beta-catenin signaling pathway is a main oxidative defense pathway, which plays essential roles in the regulation of osteoporosis (OP). The natural products possess quality therapeutic effects and few side effects. It is used as a novel strategy in the treatment of OP. However, there is no systematic study in the natural antioxidant drug based on the FoxO1/beta-catenin signaling pathway. This paper aims to discover pro-osteogenesis natural antioxidants for the prevention and treatment of OP. METHODS: Systems pharmacology; combined with reverse drug targeting, systems-ADME process, network analysis and molecular docking, was used to screen natural antioxidants based on the FoxO1/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Then in vitro experiments were performed to evaluate the osteogenesis effects of screened natural antioxidants. RESULTS: Kaempferide was screened as the most potential antioxidant to improve osteogenesis by the regulation of the FoxO1/beta-catenin signaling pathway. In vitro experiments showed that kaempferide significantly increased the expression of antioxidant genes and promoted osteogenic differentiation. Furthermore, kaempferide also improved the osteogenic differentiation inhibited by H(2)O(2) through the enhancement of antioxidant capacity. Notably, kaempferide promoted cell antioxidant capacity by the increased nuclear translocation of FoxO1 and beta-catenin. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that kaempferide is the natural antioxidant to promote osteogenesis effectively through the FoxO1/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Natural antioxidant therapy maybe a promising strategy for the prevention and treatment of OP.
abstract_zh: 背景：叉头框蛋白O1（FoxO1）/β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）信号通路是主要的氧化防御通路，在骨质疏松症（OP）的调控中发挥重要作用。天然产物具有优良的治疗效果和较少的副作用，被用作治疗OP的新策略。然而，目前尚无基于FoxO1/beta-catenin信号通路的天然抗氧化药物的系统性研究。本文旨在发现用于预防和治疗OP的促骨形成天然抗氧化剂。方法：采用系统药理学方法，结合反向药物靶向、系统ADME过程、网络分析和分子对接，基于FoxO1/beta-catenin信号通路筛选天然抗氧化剂。随后进行体外实验，评估筛选出的天然抗氧化剂的成骨效应。结果：山柰素（kaempferide）被筛选为通过调控FoxO1/beta-catenin信号通路改善成骨作用的最具潜力的抗氧化剂。体外实验表明，山柰素显著增加抗氧化基因的表达，并促进成骨分化。此外，山柰素还通过增强抗氧化能力，改善了由H(2)O(2)抑制的成骨分化。值得注意的是，山柰素通过增加FoxO1和beta-catenin的核转位来促进细胞抗氧化能力。结论：这些发现表明，山柰素是通过FoxO1/beta-catenin信号通路有效促进成骨作用的天然抗氧化剂。天然抗氧化疗法可能是预防和治疗OP的一种有前景的策略。
